findings.pdf_says: Page 232 (folio V-40) ends with the sequence-of-source-programs format ending "END PROGRAM program-name-4.]"; the title "SECTION VI: NUCLEUS MODULE" is printed at the top of page 233 (folio VI-1).

findings.why_it_matters: The section title heading sits under page 232 (the wrong page) and is duplicated on page 233 as non-heading text; the heading belongs on page 233 only.
